payload.claim: The 'Notes for the agent' section states 'The fallback is new code, so criteria 1 and 2 declare a witness and no mutant,' but the parsed acceptance frontmatter shows criterion 1 (test_ready_task_stacks_on_the_newest_branch_that_carries_its_tree_base_above_a_pushed_sha) carries nine wrong_versions and criterion 2 (test_ready_task_refuses_a_tree_base_no_branch_at_origin_carries) carries six, and the later 'Kill the wrong versions with the arrangement' paragraph discusses killing those same mutants. The notes contradict the acceptance block they describe.
